subject: RetailX POC — operations results & brief ask
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@retailx.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Aug 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: RetailX POC — operations results & brief ask

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month. We put together a short operational recap and wanted to share the headline numbers from the two-week pilot (attached one-pager + dashboard screenshot):

- Average inference cost per request down 42% (from $0.018 -> $0.0105)
- Sustained throughput 3.1x higher under production traffic profile (peaks handled without queuing)
- p50 latency improved by 18% (220ms -> 180ms) and p95 reduced from 890ms -> 420ms
- Cold-start rate reduced to <1% with our prefix caching strategy
- Estimated monthly cost savings at scale: ~$18k for RetailX’s current footprint

We’d love to feature RetailX in a short marketing blurb and was wondering two things:
1) Would you be open to a 30-second quote we can use on a one-pager and website? (I can draft the line and you can edit.)
2) If you prefer, would someone on your team be available for a 15-minute quick call next week to capture a short audio clip / confirm numbers?

I attached the one-pager and a dashboard screenshot. If you’re okay with us using the RetailX logo and the metrics above, please reply with an approval or edits.

Thanks again — big win for the ops team.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: poc-onepager.pdf (one-page summary), ops-dashboard-screenshot.png (dashboard snapshot)

From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@retailx.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 31 Aug 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RetailX POC — operations results & brief ask

Hi Mateo —

Really happy with the outcome — thanks to you and the team for moving quickly. The numbers look right from our side (I ran them past our SRE lead). A couple of small notes: the p95 in our internal logs was ~430ms not 420ms, and the cost projection is spot-on.

I’m fine with a short quote. Here’s a one-liner you can use or adjust:
"Redwood cut our inference costs nearly in half while improving tail latency — a clear win for throughput and predictability."

If possible, please send a one-line draft attributed to me (Sophie Tran, Director of Engineering, RetailX) and I’ll sign off. I’m also available for a 15-minute call on Mon 9/4 between 10–11am PT.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Tran
Director of Engineering, RetailX
sophie.tran@retailx.com
